subject.title: feat(message): list chat / list messages should support pagination instead of hardcoded 25 limit

question: Should the remaining work standardize on one shared message-action pagination contract now, or split the remaining provider pagination work into provider-specific follow-ups?
rationale: Source inspection proves the remaining gap, but the permanent API shape crosses shared runner, CLI, formatter, docs, and multiple channel adapters, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt Shared Contract
options.body: Use the open universal pagination direction as the contract, then wire each provider behind that shape.

options.title: Split By Provider
options.body: Keep the formatter fix and track Discord, Slack, Matrix, Feishu, and Teams pagination as separate provider-owned issues or PRs.

options.title: Stop At Formatter Fix
options.body: Accept metadata hints and configurable display limits without adding iterative page navigation to the message surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Use the open universal pagination direction as the contract, then wire each provider behind that shape.

likelyOwner.reason: This account reopened the issue after the partial fix and described the remaining product boundary most directly.
